{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Vegan cuisine|Vegan cuisine]]

'''Tofu bacon''' is easy to make and can be used interchangeably with bacon in most recipes. Great with breakfast or in a B.L.T.

== Ingredients ==
* 1 block extra-firm [[Cookbook:Tofu|tofu]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]]
* 3 Tbsp [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]] or [[Cookbook:Tamari|tamari]]
* 3 Tbsp [[Cookbook:Nutritional Yeast|nutritional yeast]] flakes
* Liquid smoke (optional)

== Procedure ==

#Slice the tofu into thin strips like traditional bacon.
#Fry strips in a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|pan]] on medium heat, turning once, until crispy and golden brown on each side.
#Add soy sauce and one to two drops of liquid smoke, and toss with the tofu bacon slices.
#Coat with nutritional yeast, and remove from heat.
